scope: Offline review and permitted policy/runtime/test corrections only. No provider/network/UI calls, new session/Work, private-state access, token/profile transfer, or authentication interaction by peer.

repairs_and_checks.one_guest_GET: GUEST_APP cached identical receipt does not repeat navigation. Any FILL or SEND intent blocks guest-app navigation; pending REFRESH/GUEST_APP blocks SEND. No create branch in guest-app.
repairs_and_checks.own_prompt_false_PASS: Existing user-prompt/no-model-response negative still passes. Matching bound assistant response remains OUTPUT_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_QA; collection requires matching existing SEND nonce intent.
repairs_and_checks.classification: Guest mode is GUEST_WEB_AUTH_UNVERIFIED. Composer or successful guest output cannot establish AUTH_PASS, Google account identity or independent acceptance.
repairs_and_checks.privacy: persist_profile=false remains mandatory; no cookies/profile or local Chrome auth are imported. New profile persistence would require separate explicit owner authorization.

limits: Run only within current owned-session lifetime and fresh private policy/resource checks. If expired/unavailable, release/reconcile that session; do not create a replacement or retry an uncertain send.
Policy/journal budget remains one session/one submission. Preserve old CREATE policy/journal identity and use the separate explicit guest policy without rewriting historical evidence.
This review does not authorize bypass of Google browser security checks, credential automation, captcha solving, profile persistence or importing local browser auth.
Provider/auth/UI/live claims are parent observations or future evidence; no live provider action was performed by this reviewer. Existing Chrome/runtime outside this candidate was not changed.
